exercises.title: Management practices 1 — which practice?
exercises.problemHtml:
Eight requirements management practices. Which one does each action apply?

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Management practices 1 — which practice? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Establish a change control process
   - r1.k: Perform impact analysis on requirements changes
   - r2.k: Establish baselines and control versions of requirements sets
   - r3.k: Maintain a history of requirements changes
   - r4.k: Track the status of each requirement
   - r5.k: Track requirements issues
   - r6.k: Maintain a requirements traceability matrix
   - r7.k: Use a requirements management tool
   Change control decides; impact analysis informs the decision; baselines, history, status, issues and traceability keep the agreed set under control; a tool automates much of it.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Change control decides; impact analysis informs the decision; baselines, history, status, issues and traceability keep the agreed set under control; a tool automates much of it.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

luaChon: Perform impact analysis on requirements changes
Establish baselines and control versions of requirements sets
Maintain a history of requirements changes

o.s: A CCB meets weekly to decide on proposed changes.
Before deciding, the team lists the design, code and tests a change would touch and estimates 30 hours.
The approved SRS for release 1 is tagged "v1.0-baseline".
For FR-12 the tool records who changed it, when, what and why.
A dashboard shows 40 requirements Approved, 25 Implemented, 15 Verified.
Every open question has one owner and a due date in the issue tracker.
Each functional requirement is linked to its design, code and tests.
The team stores all requirements and their attributes in Jira with an RM plug-in.

exercises.title: Management practices 3 — baselines, history and the RTM
exercises.problemHtml:

# Management practices 3 — baselines, history and the RTM — answer key

1. Two teams argue about which SRS is current. Which practice was missing?Hai nhóm cãi nhau SRS nào là bản hiện hành. Thiếu thực hành nào?
   Answer: c) Baselines and unique version identifiers
   Version control of requirements sets.VI: Kiểm soát phiên bản tập yêu cầu.

2. When should the traceability matrix be filled in?Khi nào điền ma trận truy vết?
   Answer: a) During development, as work products are created
   Late tracing is costly and inaccurate.VI: Truy vết muộn tốn và thiếu chính xác.

3. A requirement must be reverted to its earlier form. What makes this possible?Cần đưa một yêu cầu về dạng cũ. Điều gì giúp làm được?
   Answer: a) A history of requirements changes
   Change history.VI: Lịch sử thay đổi.

exercises.title: Management practices 4 — issues and the CCB
exercises.problemHtml:
On complex projects open questions, gaps and review findings are easily lost: track them with one owner per issue. A Change Control Board of stakeholders decides which changes to accept and sets their priority and target release.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Management practices 4 — issues and the CCB — answer key

1. How many owners should each requirements issue have?Mỗi vấn đề yêu cầu nên có mấy người phụ trách?
   Answer: c) Exactly one
   Shared ownership is no ownership.VI: Ai cũng phụ trách là không ai phụ trách.

2. Who decides whether a proposed change is accepted and in which release?Ai quyết thay đổi đề xuất có được nhận và vào bản nào?
   Answer: a) The Change Control Board
   The CCB.VI: CCB.
